Name: Robin Build Position
Author: rokugin
Description:
[size=5][u]Install[/u][/size][size=3]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI﻿[/url].
2. Unzip the mod folder into the Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

[/size][size=5][u]About[/u][/size][size=3]
Whenever Robin is upgrading a custom building with an interior, her default behavior is to always stand at tile position 1, 5 unless in the shed. With vanilla building's, this is fine, however custom buildings that aren't specifically designed to have that tile open will have her standing in really odd places.

This mod lets you set up a custom position for Robin to stand in while she's building or upgrading buildings, using the CustomFields field of the buildings data.
On its own, this mod has no functionality and must be coupled with editing the Data/Buildings data asset.

[url=https://github.com/rokugin/RobinBuildPosition/blob/main/docs/author-guide.md]Guide available on the GitHub[/url].

[/size][size=5][u]Compatibility[/u][/size][size=3]
Shouldn't have any compatibility issues...

[url=https://github.com/rokugin/RobinBuildPosition]Source[/url]
[/size]
